use: Templates show layout, composition, hierarchy and rhythm only. Never copy their text, numbers, claims, client names or logos: content comes from the user. Their colours, fonts and sizes need not match the design system; build every output with design-system tokens, text roles, components and assets. Pick the template whose structure fits the user's content, then adapt it.
source: Figma Design MCP, the Template frame on the outcome's page

sections.name: Cover page
sections.use: The opening slide of a deck.

templates.name: Cover · headline, stats and contact
templates.layout: Logo top-right; small eyebrow tag above a two-line headline (one line in the accent colour); one-line subline; two small stats side by side; a contact box bottom-left; footer line bottom-right; the dot-particle design element across the right half.

sections.name: Page breaker
sections.use: Section dividers between parts of a deck. Pick one of the designs. Q&A slides use this brand-theme breaker.

templates.name: Page breaker · section title
templates.layout: Full-bleed brand blue; logo (or co-branding lockup) top-right; small dark tag above a large one-line section title, left and centred vertically; a single row of proof points along the bottom.

sections.name: Content slides
sections.use: Layouts for normal content slides: a starting point adapted to the user's content.

templates.name: Concept chart with layer row
templates.layout: Eyebrow, then a two-line title with the key phrase in brand blue; one large annotated line chart filling the middle (two curves crossing, callouts on the curves); a full-width brand bar with a grid of six labels beneath it as a layer diagram.

templates.name: Journey table
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted phrase and a subtitle; a full-width table: a dark header row of stages across the top, rows for a growth chart, application chips and customer logos, with row labels in a coloured left column.

templates.name: Two maps with headline stat
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted figure; two map panels side by side, each with bubble markers sized by value and a short caption; a large stat chip on a dark tile bottom-left with a one-line explanation; footnote.

templates.name: Three phases, growing
templates.layout: Two-line title with highlights; three phase cards left to right (done, now, next), each larger than the last, the last on brand blue with an arrow shape; each card has a phase tag, name, one-line goal, bullets and logos.

templates.name: Bar chart with summary card
templates.layout: One-line title; stacked bar chart on the left two thirds with a legend and labelled values; a summary card on the right listing segments with ranges.

templates.name: Three numbered steps with metrics
templates.layout: Two-line title with the key words in the accent colour; three numbered circles on a connector line; three cards below, each with a label, short description, an icon, a large metric in the accent colour and a caption.

templates.name: Build or buy comparison cards
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted phrase; two labelled groups side by side, each with a neutral card and a brand-filled card (the Faclon option); a full-width dark statement bar along the bottom.

templates.name: Statement with three stat cards
templates.layout: Brand background; a large two-line statement with an accent phrase and a one-line subline; three stat cards in a row (two darker blue, one white), each with an icon tile, label, large number and description.

sections.name: Product stack
sections.use: Used as designed whenever the product stack is asked for.

templates.name: Product stack · layers
templates.layout: Eyebrow and two-line title with accent words; an isometric stack illustration on the left; a column of product layers, each a row with name, category tag and one-line description; an outlined panel on the right with four short statements.

templates.name: Architecture · on top of existing systems
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted second clause; columns flowing left to right (sources, single source of truth, activated with AI), then a brand arrow bar and a grid of partner and system logos.

templates.name: One foundation, many uses
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted phrase; a full-width brand bar naming the foundation, with connectors down to five use-case cards (example label, use case, large metric); a full-width dark statement bar at the bottom.

sections.name: Dashboard and product slides
sections.use: Product, demo and dashboard slides: a demo photo, a product screenshot, or phone and desktop views, with a statement, steps or points. Rebuilt in the Faclon design system; swap the screenshots for Faclon Labs product views.

templates.name: Demo with title
templates.layout: A large demo photo or image on the left two thirds with a small label tag on it; a short title on the right; logo top-right.

templates.name: Steps, statement and screenshot
templates.layout: A row of step tabs across the top with the current step highlighted; a two-line statement; one large desktop screenshot below.

templates.name: Steps, points and screenshots
templates.layout: Step tabs across the top; a statement on the left with two arrow-led points; overlapping desktop and phone screenshots on the right.

templates.name: Steps, title, list card and phone
templates.layout: Step tabs across the top; a large three-line title on the left with a small list card of requisites below it; a phone screenshot on the right.

sections.name: Team slide
sections.use: Default for about or team slides, unless the user gives feedback.

templates.name: Team grid with stats and map
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted number; a grid of headshots (four across, two rows), each with name in brand blue, role and credential logos; four stat tiles bottom-left; a world map with office pins bottom-right.

templates.name: About company · stats and client logos
templates.layout: Title with a highlighted figure; a left column of four large stats with captions; a right-hand grid of client logos with a caption above it; a one-line note bottom-left.

sections.name: Closing slide
sections.use: The last slide of a deck. Pick one of the designs.

templates.name: Closing statement
templates.layout: Brand blue; logo top-right; a small dark tag (website) above a large three-line closing statement with accent words; the dot-particle design element on the right.

templates.name: Closing · statement and stats bento
templates.layout: A dark rounded panel inset on brand blue: logo, two-line statement, one-line description and a CTA button on the left; a bento grid of stat tiles with brand-blue squares on the right.
